messages:
elaine: quick check — compact stats panel in the console update. on keyboard nav, the focus ring is hard to see against the gradient header. screenshot attached: https://redwood.dev/snap/comp-stats. want to avoid adding big visual noise. thoughts?

mike: saw it. reproduces on chrome + firefox. focus ring is 1px #cbd5e0 — not enough contrast.

sofia: agree. also screenreader reads just 'button' for each stat, not descriptive. we should add proper ids / aria-labels so SR users know what they'll open.

ben: is this the flow where cards are tabbable? we made them role=button for click-to-open details. maybe change to link or add aria-describedby?

elaine: yeah role=button was easiest for keyboard activation. proposal: keep role=button for semantics, add aria-label="Open metric details: {metric name}" and increase focus ring to 2px solid #2b6cb0 (brand blue).

sofia: prefer using outline + outline-offset to avoid layout shift. example: ```css
.stat-card:focus{
  outline:2px solid #2b6cb0;
  outline-offset:2px;
}
```
Also add `aria-label` and `aria-describedby` pointing to a visually-hidden element with the metric value. SR example: "Total requests, 1.2k, button" — more useful than just "button".

mike: sounds good. tiny perf nit: avoid box-shadow for focus, it forces paints on hover. outline is way cheaper.

a11y-bot: Automated audit complete — contrast issue flagged for `.stat-label` on dark gradient (contrast ratio 3.8:1). WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text. Flag id: A11Y-2401.

ben: :eyes: can we lighten the label to #f1f5f9 or increase font-weight? maybe make the numeric value bolder and keep label lighter.

elaine: action items: 1) dev implement outline + aria labels (mike). 2) designer tweak color/weight (me). 3) a11y audit rerun (sofia). target: include in Friday release. ok?

mike: on it — will create PR today. quick question: aria-describedby should reference `sr-value-<metric>` hidden span or inline `aria-label` with the value?

sofia: prefer `aria-labelledby` combining visible title and hidden value: pattern: `<div role=\"button\" aria-labelledby=\"title-requests value-requests\">`. less brittle for screenreaders.

elaine: thanks all — i'll post updated mocks after lunch and link the PR here. :thumbsup:
